name: Pancorbo (Spain)
description: Square flag of three horizontal stripes of yellow, red and white in the proportions 1:2:1, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pancorbo (a castle between two figures on red).
history: The arms and the flag were approved officially on 4 June 1999 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 121 of 25 June 1999); the flag is red in the central third (0.50), yellow in the upper third (0.25) and white in the lower third (0.25), or gules, or and argent, square according to the ordinances of Castilla y León, with the municipal arms at its heart.
